DAAD Master Studies Scholarship Opportunities for All Disciplines

The German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) offers comprehensive scholarships for foreign graduates to complete postgraduate studies in Germany.

Eligibility Summary

  • Completed Bachelor degree not older than 6 years.
  • Proficiency in language of instruction (German or English).

Grant Value

Scholarship holders receive €934 per month, travel allowance, and insurance.

Annual deadline: 15 November 2026.

Apply via DAAD Portal
